listing.name: Me
listing.googleShortDescription: Connect, share and learn in an adult community, at your own pace.
listing.description:
Me is designed for adults living with dementia, family carers and other adult community members.

Connect with people, share text stories with chosen audiences, and take part in groups. Keep in touch through messages and explore reviewed learning and country resources. Choose Simple View and low-data preferences to suit how you use Me.

Me is for adults aged 18 and over. Me is not an emergency service, medical care, a diagnostic tool or a treatment. Learning and community content do not replace advice from a qualified professional.

This is a draft description for a future verified release. It must be reconciled with the exact enabled features and completed native journeys before use in a store.
listing.testNotes: Controlled beta candidate only. Keep incomplete features disabled. Do not advertise uploads, reels or completed account setup while their release holds remain.
